rules.name: Unverified Account Pre-Flight Interception
rules.description: If user credentials exist but email is unverified, login redirects immediately to /email-verification-required without full token grant.

rules.name: CV Health Score Scale

rules.name: Candidate Profile ↔ Primary Active Resume Synchronization
rules.description: Updates to candidate profile trigger bio & title updates to primary active website resume to prevent model split.
